findings.highlight: My right arm throbs in pain.
findings.evidenceJa: ジクジクと右手が痛む。
findings.governingReading: 右手 is the right hand supporting painful awareness here.
findings.explanation: Painful right hand becomes right arm.

findings.governingReading: 弱気になるな is self-directed resistance to discouragement.
findings.explanation: Command not to lose heart becomes report of feeling unwell.

findings.highlight: She inches closer, her murderous intent clear.
findings.evidenceJa: ……ぞわり、と忍び寄ってくる殺気。
findings.governingReading: 忍び寄ってくる modifies the sensed murderous intent, not Rider’s bodily movement.
findings.explanation: Creeping killing intent becomes Rider physically moving closer.
